payload.title: Scheduled publishing and automated announcements
payload.description:
Publish Stories at chosen times so a fast newsroom can spread its work out, and announce each qualifying Story on X as soon as it qualifies, automatically. A general Papyrus capability; Machines on Machines (MoM) proves it first, 5-star Stories only, on a private test account first.

Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md (plan PR into develop). Asked by Ryan, 2026-11-12.

**Scheduling.** Four fields on the scheduled version's Item row (`scheduledPublishAt`, `scheduledBy`, `scheduledAt`, `scheduleState`, plus `scheduleName`), one sparse index `scheduleState+scheduledPublishAt`, one EventBridge Scheduler one-off schedule per scheduled version (the newsletter and home-page pattern). The schedule pins an immutable version; a newer version blocks the publish and tells the editor. UTC stored, publication time zone shown. Needs the first-publish-time fix (PPY-271940) so a scheduled republish keeps the first date.

**Announcements.** Through Caducus (Ryan's one-notification-system decision, PPY-824c14): a new `x` channel, a `broadcast` recipient class and a cost field on deliveries (Caducus issue needed). Papyrus owns eligibility (published and rated at or above the site's announcement floor, never below the quality floor PPY-0e8d66), model-drafted text checked against the Story, optional approval, budget and pause, retirement.

**Accounts.** The site owner's own X developer app (the owner pays X); OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE; client secret and rotating refresh token in SSM SecureString per site and account.

**Calendar.** FullCalendar 7 (MIT), client-only on the schedule page; spike in spikes/scheduling-calendar/.

**Stories.** Scheduling backend; schedule field and badge; schedule view; channel framework + X adapter; account connection; eligibility rules + settings UI; drafting + approval; audit trail; cost, budget, pause; retirement and corrections; CLI/MCP parity; p.apyr.us page; MoM rollout.

**Acceptance.** On MoM, an editor schedules a Story, it publishes at that time with the right dates, and if it is rated 5 stars a reviewed post with its link appears on MoM's X account once, with its cost recorded and visible; pausing stops all posting; retiring the Story deletes the post.
